build_RealNVP_model: build a RealNVP flow-based generative model for 2D density estimation with coupling layers
create_scale_network: create a scale network with linear layers and tanh activation for invertible mapping
create_translation_network: create a translation network with linear layers for invertible coupling transformation
run_backward_mapping: run the backward mapping to transform data space to latent space with log determinant
calculate_log_probability: calculate the log probability of samples using the RealNVP prior distribution
